# Jake Worsham

> A working software portfolio with isolated, interactive demonstrations.

- /prospects/: Sales prospect workflow, contacts, pipeline, notes, and exports.
- /helga/: Voice and text assistant with a personal task and calendar workspace.
- /receptionist/: Browser-based customer intake and callback summaries.
- /documents/: Notes to editable documents and PDF exports.
- /rfp/: Reference-grounded proposal drafting.
- /cms/: Draft, preview, and publish a sample website.

All business data in the demonstrations is fictional. Contact: jake@syncgr.com.
